items.title: A cast of five
items.text: Nocturne, Blaze, Frost, Miko and Cloud: drawn as pixel art, each with its own voice.

items.title: Phosphor green
items.text: The whole app, the characters and the panel now run on one green LED palette.

items.title: Giovanni
items.text: Renamed, rebranded and rebuilt by Tushar Gautam. No update feed: this copy stays yours.

items.title: Ears and capes that move
items.text: The pup’s ears and the fighters’ spikes swing as Giovanni moves across the screen.

items.title: No marketing links
items.text: The About page shows the maker and the license, and nothing else.
